dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qcqe](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qcqe) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 48.687 depth occurred on Jul 15 2025 3km SE of Sarrat. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 18.1361 longitude 120.6545. It impacted 200658 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
